jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.description:
CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER
Residential HVAC Services — Fort Lauderdale, FL
Flying Horse Capital | Ownership Track

THE OPPORTUNITY

Flying Horse Capital has acquired a residential HVAC services company in the Fort Lauderdale market—a founder-owned and operated business with more than 20 years of history and approximately $6M in annual revenue. We are looking for the next CEO to lead the business through its next chapter. If you came up through the trade, have been running somebody else's shop, and have wondered when you would get the opportunity to build something of your own, this is that seat. Real equity. Real authority. And an owner behind you who is not operating on a five-year clock.

ABOUT FLYING HORSE CAPITAL

We are a Dallas-based permanent capital firm that acquires lower-middle-market family- and founder-owned businesses. We are not a private equity fund. No fund life. No five-year clock. No forced exit. We buy good businesses and hold them.

THE ROLE

You run the company—the P&L, the team, the customers, and the outcome.
This is a $6M business, not a corporate platform. There is no large corporate infrastructure behind you. You will be close to the technicians, the customers, and the numbers every day.

You will own:

Field operations
— dispatch, scheduling, service delivery, installation crews, fleet, inventory, permitting, and safety
The crew
— technician recruiting, retention, development, and accountability. At this size, losing two good technicians is a material event, particularly in a highly competitive labor market
Customers
— service standards, callback rates, online reputation, customer retention, and maintenance-agreement growth
Unit economics
— gross margin by service line, labor utilization, average ticket, close rates, and overall profitability
Growth
— strengthening the core business and expanding market share across Broward and adjacent counties
Culture
— maintaining what made the business successful while building the accountability, processes, and team required for its next stage of growth

YOU WILL NOT BE DOING THIS ALONE

A structured 90-day handoff from the founder—accounts, vendors, referral sources, customer relationships, and the institutional knowledge that lives in no system
A fractional CFO provided by Flying Horse Capital to own reporting, cash management, budgeting, and lender relationships. You own the P&L; you will not be in QuickBooks at midnight

A Sales Director we will fund and recruit once the business is stabilized, reporting directly to you
Support navigating the licensing and qualifying-agent transition, including applicable examination or licensing requirements
Direct access to ownership. One phone call. Fast decisions.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You started in the field as a hands-on HVAC technician. You have run diagnostics, pulled a compressor, and had the hard conversation with a homeowner in August
You have since led—as a service manager, operations manager, GM, or branch manager—in a multi-truck residential HVAC environment
You have carried accountability for roughly $3M+ in revenue and 10+ field personnel. You do not need to have run a large platform. You need to have run something real, and run it well

You understand the economics of a residential service business and know how technician productivity, pricing, close rates, callbacks, and customer retention ultimately flow through the P&L
You want ownership, not a bigger title

You are relentlessly hands-on. At this size, that is not a preference—it is the job

Strongly preferred:
An active Florida CAC license or candidates positioned to meet applicable Florida licensing requirements. Also valued: maintenance-program growth experience, South Florida or Gulf Coast market experience, and bilingual English/Spanish capabilities. If you hold an applicable Florida license, lead with it.

COMPENSATION

Meaningful equity participation a genuine owner alongside Flying Horse Capital, not a token grantee
Long-term opportunity to build personal wealth through the growth of the business

LOCATION

Fully onsite in greater Fort Lauderdale / Broward County. Candidates requiring relocation are encouraged to apply.

OUR VIEW

We believe the right CEO is the single most important factor in a successful ownership transition. The capital and the structure are replaceable. The operator is not.
We are selective about who we partner with. We are looking for an operator who wants to take real ownership of a business, build something lasting, and participate directly in the value they create.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Our client was established in 1888, is a manufacturer producing primarily aluminum, low carbon and stainless steel wire mesh and fine wire for industrial and consumer markets. Located in York County, they have two manufacturing plants twenty minutes apart.

They have retained our services to help them fill an important role in their Sales and Business Development group. We are looking for a strong Business Development Manager to come in and be the principal person for prospecting and pursuing new client leads, while managing the ongoing new business pipeline. This individual will be pivotal in their sales team responsible for developing proposals and presentations for best business capture, while collaborating with the companies customer service, sales, engineering and operational team members for successful onboarding of new business.

Requirements

5 years of experience with sales prospecting technical products
Experience with metals fabrication and/or the metals market
Reading of technical drawings and schematics
Strong written and verbal communication skills
ERP systems
Ability to travel
